purpose: Imagine an unlikely possibility or warn of a consequence.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
Potential V + ものなら; V volitional + ものなら
If I could, I would like to return to that day.
If you really can do it alone, go ahead and try.
If anyone were to use fire here, it would cause a major accident.
formation: Potential V + ものなら; V volitional + ものなら
restrictions: Potential forms often express a wish or challenge; volitional forms often introduce danger.
mistake: Check the preceding verb form before interpreting the conditional.
